cases.rationale: An actual man sits in a single-person office chair, and a recognizable drinking tumbler stands on the purple surface. The small black handheld object in his lap is too indistinct to distinguish a remote from a cell phone or another device, so remote (65) and cell phone (67) remain unclear. The tea-bearing purple surface could be a small eating table or a shop work surface/counter, leaving dining table (60) unclear. Packaged merchandise and printed portraits do not establish additional actual category objects. All 75 definitions were considered; the other categories lack identifiable objects in this crop.

A brown-and-white dog reaches toward a bright yellow flying disc at the upper-right edge; its broad disc form and interaction support frisbee rather than fruit or another yellow object. A blurred terracotta container appears in the rear-left garden area, but the blur prevents confirming that the adjacent vegetation grows in it, so potted plant (58) is unclear. Grass, fence and the remaining background provide no identifiable objects for the other definitions. All 75 definitions were considered.

Three actual people sit behind several unmistakable pizzas on an eating table. A straight-sided drinking glass is visible between the pizzas and the central diner, supporting cup rather than stemmed wine glass. Dark condiment objects at the lower-left edge are partly clipped and include shaker/grinder-like forms; the possible bottle lacks enough visible neck/body detail, so bottle (39) remains unclear. Pizza toppings do not identify any of the separately defined fruits or vegetables. The dark wall banquette does not supply a clearly upholstered couch or separate chair. All 75 definitions were considered, with no other unresolved category ambiguity.

The lower-left edge shows a toilet seat/bowl, and the right side shows a pedestal washbasin. A narrow green floral vase on the windowsill holds a cut white flower, establishing vase rather than a growing potted plant or drinking vessel. The large fixture at lower right is a bathtub, excluded from sink/bowl/toilet alternatives. The small sill containers have no identifiable plants. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two actual people hold white motion-game remote controllers with wrist cords, supporting remote and excluding phone or toothbrush interpretations. Beige upholstered seating behind them is substantially occluded; its visible cushion and arm/back do not resolve single-person chair versus sofa, so chair (56) and couch (57) remain unclear. A small red seating fragment at lower right does not settle that distinction. Shirt graphics and logos do not count as actual animals or other objects. All 75 definitions were considered.

A child sits on the wooden floor and holds an identifiable orange section at the mouth. The open refrigerator, including its door bins and body, is visible behind the child, and a green glass bottle with neck is identifiable in the door. Other containers include a cooking pot and small jars/cans, which do not establish cups or bowls under the definitions. The small yellow floor object is toy-like and does not identify actual banana fruit. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The close crop contains a split bread roll, shredded orange carrot and white sauce beneath a long browned sausage. The shredded carrot pieces are identifiable. The sausage could be a frankfurter or another sausage, so hot dog (52) remains unclear under the explicit generic-sausage restriction. Because this determines whether the filled bread is excluded as a hot dog or qualifies as a sandwich, sandwich (48) also remains unclear. The white supporting surface is plate-like rather than a bowl, and no table context is established. All 75 definitions were considered.

A buffet tray at right holds smooth, rounded-end frankfurters, identifiable as hot-dog food without buns; the left tray contains bacon. The white rectangular serving vessels have raised sides but are shallow enough that bowl versus platter identity is unresolved, so bowl (45) remains unclear. The visible metal serving implements appear to be tongs rather than identifiable fork, knife or spoon. This is a buffet counter, which does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

Actual children in sports clothing stand and run on grass beside a soccer goal and net. Their visible faces, arms and legs establish person. The goal posts/net and clothing do not match any other supplied object category, and no ball, racket, board, bag or actual animal is visible. All 75 exact definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A black wire fruit bowl contains green grapes, a red/yellow apple at front left, textured orange fruit at lower right and behind the grapes, and curved yellow bananas at right. The basket forms an identifiable open fruit bowl, while grapes and dark purple fruit do not introduce additional supplied categories. The dark support has no identifiable dining-table context. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual airplane wing and associated aerodynamic structure enter from the upper-left corner above a broad aerial landscape. The wing geometry and airborne view establish airplane parts, while terrain ridges and distant ground markings do not identify cars, buildings with category appliances, animals or other supplied objects. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A real black-and-white cat sits upright on a striped bed covering with rumpled bedding visible to the left. A striped necktie hangs from its white collar, clearly supporting tie rather than a scarf or printed pattern. The cat is an actual animal rather than plush, and the soft horizontal bedding context supports bed without a separately identifiable couch or chair. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
